crossRefs.note: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here, and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”
Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness…
Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
translations.bsb: Jesus answered, “Are there not twelve hours of daylight? If anyone walks in the daytime, he will not stumble, because he sees by the light of this world.
translations.kjv: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
translations.asv: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If a man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
